text:
Type: black metal dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table, kitchen island or work table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, farmhouse
Materials: matte black painted steel shade, brass-colored fittings, black-and-white braided textile cord, black ceiling cup
Colors: matte black, brass, white shade interior
Shape: wide flared dome shade with a narrow neck and brass yoke, hangs on a braided cord, classic workshop silhouette, medium visual weight
Feel: bold, grounded, vintage, warm
Goes with: wood dining tables, brick, concrete, black and brass accents; industrial or farmhouse kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: RANARP
product.description: Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
